or adjusted body weight for obese patients could potentially 
be used to calculate energy requirements. For example, in the
American College of Chest Physicians equation, BMI deter-
mines the weight that is used in the calculation (see Table 3.12).

metabolically active tissue and represents the largest propor-
tion of the REE. Historically, the rationale for use of an adjusted
body weight was based on the assumption that 20%–25% of fat
